_source: App screenshots from Nordine's testing of the post-validation build (judge V1.14 / prompts V2.6), supplied 2026-09-04.
_status: Regressions on non-target classification. Diagnosis: docs/ApiSave_Postvalidation_v2_Diagnosis.md. No code changed yet — awaiting client sign-off on the fix direction.
_note: These are APP SCREENSHOTS, not raw insect photos. The original photographs have been requested from the client so each case can be run through scripts/postval-regression.cjs. `expected_verdict` / `prohibited_verdicts` below are the target once the fix lands.

cases.subject: Dark insect on an open hexagonal comb nest (paper-wasp / Polistes type — NOT a velutina carton nest); backlit, slightly soft.
cases.observed_motif: Q1 + Q2 + Q3 = OUI valides sur le même individu.
cases.note: CRITICAL false positive. Nest morphology alone (open comb, no envelope) excludes velutina. Symmetrical exclusion gate must catch this before the ROUGE short-circuit.

cases.subject: Wasp (Vespula/Polistes), regular yellow bands across the whole abdomen; readable.
cases.observed_motif: Morphologie déviante mais profil chromatique crabro : seconde photo requise pour exclure une variante velutina atypique.
cases.note: verrouVert Q3=NON branch: nbMorpho===0 && antiCrabroHit>=1 && nbTotal<3 -> RETAKE_LIGHTING_ANGLE. Multiple regular bands should conclude 'other vespid'.

cases.subject: Wasp on a purple flower, regular yellow bands; sharp, outdoor daylight.
cases.note: Same branch as IMG_8523. Reason label ('use direct natural light') wrong — shot in full sun.

cases.subject: Hoverfly (Volucella, hornet-mimic FLY — huge eyes, single wing pair, no waist); very sharp, full sun.
cases.note: Not a hymenopteran. Sharp daylight. Should not request a retake.

cases.subject: European hornet (Vespa crabro), dead on its side — yellow abdomen with dark marks, reddish thorax; sharp.
cases.note: Final fallback of verrouVert -> RETAKE_SHARPER ('blurry image'). Image is sharp.
